items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The ones from Blue Note, whatever he did with Blue Note was two- track. Whenever he came over to Creed we had multi-track, we used multi-track. I don’t remember using two-track with Jimmy’s band.

ctx.x: Well we never had a large quantity of musicians on two-track. By that time I was in multi-track.
Multi-track, yeah. I know, I just mean the Jimmy Smith dates Oliver Nelson, those are direct to two-track. No.

No, the only two-track Jimmy Smith was at the remotes. I don’t remember tunes with two-tracks. The ones from Blue Note, whatever he did with Blue Note was two- track. Whenever he came over to Creed we had multi-track, we used multi-track. I don’t remember using two-track with Jimmy’s band. I wish I had sometime. When I used to go on vacation…
